name: Hatsuse Minato
source: When you look at her you see a busty beauty, but she is in fact a casual and lazy woman. She is a fujoshi that loves otome and BL games with a tendency to escape marriages. Often pushes troubles to the protagonist, but her character makes you unable to dislike her.
